while [ $i -lt $TOTAL ]; do
  i=$((i + 1))
  if [ $i -eq $next ]; then
    percent=$((i * 100 / TOTAL))
    j=$STEP
    progressBar="["
    while [ $j -le $i ]; do
        progressBar=$(printf "%s%s" "$progressBar" "▨")
        j=$((j + STEP))
    done
    while [ $j -lt $TOTAL ]; do
        progressBar=$(printf "%s%s" "$progressBar" "◻")
        j=$((j + STEP))
    done
    progressBar=$(printf "%s%s" "$progressBar" "]")
    echo "Progress: $progressBar ${percent}%"
    next=$((next + STEP))
  fi
done

echo "Benchmark completed."
